name: Does G1's rule work on coins picked at the time

sections.hypothesis: G1's rule (btc-rotation-8, unchanged) run on coins picked at each date, instead of its hindsight list, still beats BTC held and beats the same coins held equally, on Sharpe after costs, over 2018-01 to 2025-10.
sections.rationale: G1 trades a fixed list of 8 coins that are large today (BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, DOGE, LINK, DOT, LTC). Its own-coins backtest (Sharpe 1.57 from 2018-08-17) and its win over those coins held equally (1.08, findings 33) both use that list, so neither says whether the list itself, chosen knowing which coins survived and grew, made the result (findings 15). This note removes the hindsight: each Sunday G1 may hold only that week's 8 coins with the highest 30-day median volume and a year of unbroken history, picked as large-basket picks its coins, from every coin then trading, delisted ones included. Who pays is unchanged from G1: the regime and ranking ride trend and cross-sectional momentum among large coins while BTC is in an uptrend and step aside otherwise (time-series momentum, Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen 2012; crypto momentum, Liu, Tsyvinski and Wu 2022). Disclosed: G1's settings were searched on the exploration half, whose coins are in this run's universe, so this is not out-of-sample evidence for the rule; it measures how much of the backtest the coin list carried. The locked confirmation half (XRP, ADA, AVAX, TRX and others) stays out, as for every universe run: the candidates are the top 8 among the coins the engine may use. That split was random and fixed before any look, so it narrows the set without adding hindsight. The family is momentum, not a rejected one; cross-sectional momentum across all coins without a regime filter failed (the 'Every hypothesis' table: -92% and -95% drawdowns), which is why the BTC filter stays.
sections.rules: btc-rotation-top8 with G1's defaults: each Sunday's daily close (UTC), if BTC closes more than 3% above its 50-day average, hold the 3 coins with the highest 90-day return among that week's top 8 by 30-day median quote volume (at least 365 days of unbroken history, at least 1 million USDT a day), each given 1/3 of equity times min(1, 50% / its annualised volatility of the last 30 daily log returns); otherwise cash. Filled at Monday's open. Daily bars, 330 USDT, kestrel.toml's costs and spread bands, warm-up as G1 (reads 400 days before the start; scored from when a year of history exists). 2018-01 to 2025-10, never the holdout. Two runs: (1) kestrel backtest UNIVERSE --strategy btc-rotation-top8 --research <this note> --interval 1d --start 2018-01 --end 2025-10; (2) its control, the same weekly top 8 held equally with no signal: kestrel backtest UNIVERSE --strategy large-basket --param top_n=8 --param min_history_days=365 --param min_volume_musd=1, same period.
sections.falsification: Two tests, both needed, each over the same days: (A) its Sharpe after costs beats BTC held (G1's benchmark), with its return beating BTC at its average exposure reported beside; (B) its Sharpe beats the control's. Both pass: the list did not make G1's backtest; the rule works on coins it could have picked then. Either fails: G1's own-coins result owes its margin to the list, and G1's pursue rests only on its holdout year (a coin set fixed before 2025-11, findings 15) and its paper record. Reported either way, deciding nothing: its Sharpe against G1's own-coins 1.57 and the own-coins basket's 1.08; deflated Sharpe at the main pool's count; the coins it held most and how often each was in the top 8; daily correlation with G1's own-coins run. Any change to G1's decision waits for Luke.
sections.parameters: G1's defaults, fixed: top_n 3, lookback_days 90, btc_days 50, margin_pct 3, vol_days 30, target_vol_pct 50; basket of 8, 365 days of history, 1 million USDT median volume (fixed in code, as large-basket's own settings for the control). No grid, no walk-forward, no robustness: the question is the coin list, not the settings.
sections.costs: Weekly decisions on up to 3 coins, each paying the spread band of its volume (top-8 coins pay the narrowest bands); about G1's turnover. Trials: 2 in the main pool (the strategy and its control), 881 to 883.

history.reason: Passed both tests (Luke, 2026-11-26): Sharpe 1.08 vs 0.94 for BTC and 0.65 for the weekly top 8 held equally, 2018-08-17 to 2025-10; findings 34.

trial_log.strategy_name: BTC-regime rotation, top 3 of the week's top 8 by volume by 90d (BTC > 50d +3%)
